9 L
etter of 
Recommendation O O O
• Free format
•  Letter of Recommendation from the Academic Advisor (or Chief of Department or Dean of College ) of the
University Graduated
10 Financial Certiﬁcations O O O
•  Bank statement showing a balance of USD 20,000 or more, issued by a bank in the applicant’s home
country or Korea, with the balance maintained for at least one month.
※  
The account must be under the name of (1) the applicant, or (2) a parent, or (3) a spouse. If the account holder is a parent 
or spouse, the personal information section of Application Form IV must be completed and signed by the account holder.
•  
Applicants receiving scholarships from a government or other institutions except Ajou University: must
submit a certiﬁcate of a scholarship.
•  If the ﬁnancial guarantor is a faculty member of Ajou University, no additional ﬁnancial documents are
required.
※ I
f admitted, the department will issue the necessary documents for visa application.

hotocopy of 
Passport O O O • Those who have ARC submit a photocopy of ARC together

Certiﬁcate 
of Language 
Proﬁciency 
O O O

※ No other English pr
oﬁciency test scores will be accepted.

ll test results should have valid expiration dates until the submission date
